Promise.Promise1Liner: Your core promise in one powerful sentence with timeframe and mechanism

PromiseComponents.NegativeRemoval: What they avoid (without drugs, side effects, etc.)

Mechanism.CanonicalParagraph: Your unique mechanism explained in 100-150 words. This is the "how it works" that differentiates you from alternatives. Use this exact language across all assets to maintain consistency.

MechanismComponents.CoreConcept: The main idea in one sentence
MechanismComponents.Differentiation: Why this is different from alternatives

Pillar.Label: Real transformation, not theory
Pillar.KeyPoint: Founder credibility statement - personal experience that led to creating this solution
Pillar.UsageGuidance: Use early in sales page (credibility), opening of VSL (connection), briefly in emails (relatability)
Pillar.EmotionalResonance: Relatability, trust, "they get it because they lived it"

Pillar.Label: Science-backed approach
Pillar.KeyPoint: Research, studies, or clinical validation that supports the mechanism
Pillar.UsageGuidance: Use mid-page (mechanism explanation), in objection handling, briefly in emails for credibility
Pillar.EmotionalResonance: Authority, legitimacy, "this is real science, not pseudoscience"

Pillar.Label: Real people, real results
Pillar.KeyPoint: Specific user outcomes with numbers - verified results from actual customers
Pillar.UsageGuidance: Use throughout (proof of promise), in objection handling, multiple testimonials in emails and VSL
Pillar.EmotionalResonance: Social proof, "people like me succeeded", hope without hype

SpecificTestimonials.Featured: "Specific testimonial quote that demonstrates the transformation and includes concrete details"
"Another powerful testimonial with specific outcomes and authentic voice"

ProofOrchestration.Reason: Story → Science → Social Proof = credibility + relatability + proof

Objection.Statement: I've tried everything—why would this work when nothing else has?
Objection.Counter: Your counter-argument that reframes the objection and explains why your approach is different. Focus on the mechanism or root cause that other solutions missed.
Objection.PlacementGuidance: Address early (sales page section 3-4, email 2-3, VSL minute 2-3)

Objection.Statement: This seems expensive—what if it doesn't work for me?
Objection.Counter: Address with guarantee, value comparison, or cost of inaction. Make the investment feel proportional to the outcome.
Objection.PlacementGuidance: Address mid-page (after mechanism, before CTA), in FAQ, email 4-5, VSL minute 8

Objection.Statement: I don't have time for another complicated program
Objection.Counter: Explain the actual time investment and how it fits into busy lives. Be specific about minutes per day.

Objection.Statement: What if my situation is different/special?
Objection.Counter: Acknowledge the variety of situations while explaining what the core mechanism addresses. Include disclaimer if medical/legal needed.
Objection.PlacementGuidance: Address in FAQ, email 6, briefly in VSL disclaimers

Objection.Statement: Can't I just figure this out myself?
Objection.Counter: Acknowledge they could while explaining the time, trial-and-error, and expertise you've compressed into the system.

ObjectionOrchestration.Priority: Address 1, 2, 3 in every asset; 4, 5 optional depending on length

CTA.WhyNowReal: Real reason to act now - cohort limits, seasonal timing, or launch window. Must be verifiable and true.
CTA.NextStep: Click below to choose your tier (Core / Premium / VIP), enter your details, and you'll get immediate access to [digital component] plus shipment tracking for [physical component].

NarrativeSpine.CoreArc: Frustrated state → Discovery of root cause → Hope through mechanism → Transformation → New normal

OriginBeats.Beat: The realization: what's really causing it
The solution: how your system works
The proof: real people, real results
The choice: continue as is or try what works

NarrativeSpine.IdentityShift: From: "I'm broken, nothing works, I'll always struggle" To: "I now understand the real cause and have the right solution. I'm someone who [achieved outcome]."

NarrativeConsistency.EmailSequence: Spread across 7 emails, one beat per email

PromiseCheck.Rule: All assets must use core promise or close paraphrase
PromiseCheck.Tolerance: Variation allowed in phrasing, not in claim

MechanismCheck.Rule: All assets must mention core mechanism by name
MechanismCheck.Tolerance: Can abbreviate in emails/ads, must be full in sales page/VSL

ProofCheck.Rule: All assets must reference at least 2 of 3 proof pillars
ProofCheck.Minimum: Pillar 3 (user results) mandatory in every asset

ObjectionCheck.Rule: Objections 1-3 must be addressed in every long-form asset
At minimum, Objection 1 must be addressed in all assets

CTACheck.Rule: All CTAs must use preferred verbs, never avoid verbs
WhyNow must be authentic, not fake urgency
